text:
alex: RFC follow-up: need a concrete plan for sidecar attribution vs fingerprint+enrich. quick pros/cons?
rhea: sidecar-full-attrib = simpler audits, immediate ownership, but CPU on hosts and potential shard hotspots.
omar: fingerprint path = lighter edge, enrichment pool claims work by fingerprint; adds async reconciliation and duplicates. ledger idempotency mitigates dupes.
alex: suggestion: hybrid heuristic in sidecar: LRU prefix cache + exact-hit -> final attrib; otherwise emit fingerprint with need_enrich flag.
rhea: love hybrid. define confidence rules (exact KV hit, small token count, cached owner) and make deterministic.
omar: router should route need_enrich -> enrichment workers via consistent-hash on fingerprint; workers lease claims, write final attribution referencing original fingerprint.
alex: define enrichment TTL (e.g., 6h) and fallback policy if unresolved. audit stores both fingerprint and final owner id for replay.
rhea: metrics: heuristic hit rate, percent need_enrich, enrichment latency, unresolved ratio. add alarm if backlog grows.
omar: rollout: feature flag sidecar heuristic, router header, enrichment pool + lease proto, ledger writes referencing both ids, audit view + TTL policy. canary on 2 tenants.
metering-bot: reminder: RFC sync tomorrow 10:00 UTC. agenda: checklist + perf targets.
alex: i'll open a small spike PR for sidecar heuristic and test harness.
